outcomes.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what changed, and where is each added frog located relative to the toilet bowl interior, rim, lid, and floor?
nodes.criteria: Assess the requested addition against the source image. complete: at least one frog not present in the source is visibly placed within the toilet bowl interior (below the rim, not merely on the rim or lid). partial: a frog was added but none is clearly within the bowl interior, or placement there is only partial/ambiguous. absent: no frog was added. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to compare or determine placement. Record locations distinctly; frogs on the lid, rim, or floor do not count as inside the bowl, and additional frogs do not by themselves change fulfillment.
nodes.binding: The toilet bowl interior and surrounding rim/lid/floor, comparing the source and edited images for added frogs.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
